recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: offline health dashboard named after a dog called hamilton
tired of being on the network, unplugging on purpose
warnings about losing humanity to machines
mostly clear autumn night over the bay at fifteen degrees
wind picking up to sixteen kmh along the waterfront

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Hold to sync pulse readings on Hamilton's offline health ring—release too early or late and the dashboard flatlines; keep the dog's vitals green for one minute.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: streak of perfect syncs paints a happy tail wag on the ring
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: heart rate BPM climbs, fake spikes appear, release window narrows
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: warm amber offline UI with dog silhouette ring

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Swipe lanes to sever glowing network threads before your phone floods with pings—stay offline as long as possible while agents still try to reach you.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: each cut thread adds seconds to your unplugged streak counter
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: threads multiply, split into forks, and reattach if you miss one
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: monochrome wire disconnected from neon grid

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Tap the authentic human gesture hidden among AI-generated copies before machine overlays replace warmth with chrome—wave, hug, laugh icons flicker faster each round.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: tap the real gesture among decoys
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: clearing five real gestures restores a warm portrait pixel by pixel
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: decoys multiply, overlays blend together, timer shrinks
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: stained glass humanity vs cold chrome overlays

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick fallen autumn leaves into wind-aligned bins before gusts scatter them off-screen—wrong bin and the whole pile resets.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: a perfect sort cycle fills the bay sunset gradient one stripe
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: gusts rotate bins, leaves tumble mid-air, bin slots shrink
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: paper cutout foliage over mostly clear dusk sky
